metadata.Title: Vortex
metadata.About: Constructed with Vortex math, each feather is a partial cardioid shape made only from straight lines. Every natural and organic thing is a product of deterministic rules; the whole of nature is a form of generative art. The feathers dance to the beat of the blockchain, They seem free, but they are not. Are you?
metadata.Usage: Press 'S' to take a snapshot. Press 'T' or double tap the screen to reveal the Menu. Press 'H' to hide the menu.
metadata.Dynamic Traits: The dance is choreographed by the Bitcoin block number. The main patterns are: (1) Vortex Numbers, where the block number does not contain 3, 6 or 9, dance in a 3D Pattern. (2) Non-Vortex numbers, where the block number includes 3, 6 or 9, dance in a 2D pattern (3) Repeating Sequences of at least two digits in the block number trigger a looping figure eight dance (4) Palindrom block numbers cause the feathers to reverse spin (5) Speed is controlled by the last digit of the block number, with 0 being slowest and 9 being fastest

metadata.title: OONA's Signature
metadata.About the artist: OONA, an anonymous conceptual artist, has been a prominent figure in the crypto art scene since her birth in 2021, shaping the discourse around technology, identity, and gender in the cryptoart landscape. Known for her distinctive mask and signature sunglasses, OONA has been instrumental in defining the role of anonymity and body within performance art and blockchain technology. Her work, often deemed provocative and confrontational, interrogates power and value - using technology to question the commodification of the female form in the digital age. // Through her performances and visual artworks, OONA has become a key figure in discussions about the role of technology in artistic sovereignty, and the representation of gender and identity in the blockchain space and contemporary art landscape at large.

metadata.title: Proof of Breast No. 1
metadata.description: In Miami, a city where crypto wealth intersects with cosmetic surgery, PROOF OF BREAST exposes the entanglement of technology, commodification, and the fight for self-sovereignty. These 3D tomosynthesis images — a form of advanced medical imaging used in mammography — offer the first publicly recorded image of OONA's breasts, now immortalized on the mother chain, Bitcoin. // This work juxtaposes Florida's contentious landscape of women's healthcare and abortion rights with the radical autonomy promised by blockchain technology. By making private medical data permanently public, PROOF OF BREAST critiques the commercialization of the female body while asserting the power of decentralized systems to reclaim self-determination. // Part of the Look Touch Own series, this piece interrogates ownership, visibility, and the politics of the body in a digital age.

metadata.CL7: About CL7:  Privately leading the NFTs world market places at Christies, Sothebys and Bonhams auction houses (physical and digital art/NFTs art works).  Bridging the physical world to the digital one, the legendary CL7 - a private and secretive art dealer in the physical world - has spent the past few years developing his visions into digital art work, by investing in the strong communities of NFTs (priority to utilities, to certifications and to holograms into the blockchain with the metaverses worlds).  He is utilizing the stewardship of his 70,000 NFTs collections on Nifty Gateway & other exchanges (Pak, Beeple, Trevor Jones and many more Top valuable ones), by becoming a large investor into space development (universe), with the overarching goal of protecting and saving the human species.    Grooming:  Specialist in French/Italian architectural antiquities, from Medieval period (8-12th century) up to 17th-18th-19th century (Gothic, Renaissance, Louis XIII, Louis XIV, Louis XV, Regency, Louis XVI original/authentic periods) including modern arts (Art Nouveau and Art Deco from Nancy city, Lorraine, East of France, corner of Switzerland country). Financial banking systems included to develop 1st and 2nd markets price security.  Studied at private (underground) schools: The Louvre Museum and The Drouot-Richelieu in Paris, France (master Museum and auctions house) over 2 decades ago.  CL7 grew up in an Art business's family in the countryside of France (Lorraine) with a focus on high end quality and mid-long term investments, and a devotion to rare, unique and exquisite historical pieces (Museum quality, high long term values), and has been doing so for over 4 decades (life-long), internationally.    Visions:  CL7 is a deep supporter of all humanity, respecting all mentalities, religions and beliefs, as long as they result in positive impacts to all communities worldwide, in collaboration with foundations and charities to help to develop the single human race, together.  His vision is to use art and NFT's as the vehicle to make a better life for all, no matter the creed, color, status, or religion.  To that end, CL7 is extremely particular about what he buys, when he buys it, and from whom he buys it from.  The blockchain is forever, and so is the impact of Sports, actions, traveling, knowledge, cultures, and education.    Film:  CL7 is tying his digital and physical worlds by starring in a new exceptional movie based on Crypto/blockchain/nfts (Mad Max style, new generation), named "The 9th Raider", which he has been developing for the last few years with a private independent production in Los Angeles, CA. Directed and produced by web3 visionnaire Dallas Santana.  CL7 has filmed with a private independent international production company to create a documentary entitled "eNFTourage" as an NFT documentary centered around CL7's background - his life from his countryside in Eastern Europe to his rise as one of the largest NFT collectors of our time - which has been in production since Art Basel miami 2021. Directed and produced by Michael Mesure.    Museum:  CL7 has also been busy building his own private museum in Lorraine, next to Switzerland, which is currently under renovation.  The goal of the museum is to bring authenticity to the NFT digital art world from his traditional art business and background. It will be 4 floors of traditional, physical art works and NFTs whereby the physicals and their NFT digital twins are displayed to prove the highest credibility from physical to digital.  The architecture and structure of the foundation of his museum was built on the top of the rock of his village of only 700 people dating back all the way to the medieval period.  In fact, the real estate and lands around the museum are parts of the original large Wild Castle, built between 920-950 A.D., over 1,000 years ago.  There, CL7 will be hosting very specific events for real collaborators, artists, investors and artistically altruistic individuals.    Curator (the Culmination):  The culmination of his life's work, and the past few years of waiting to harness his work in the NFT space, has led to this moment.  It is time for CL7 to create his own branding to his true followers, giving back to them, by being extremely careful with who his selection of collaborators, real artists, investors, and partners are in order to provide his community, and the world at large, projects with deep life meaning and purpose.    In his own (uniquely French) words:  "I, CL7, I do come from no-where some how (with my entire respect to my people where I grew up, in the old school way, that somehow teach me strong deep life), with always having the believe that we can all of us do something good here, wherever we come from, whatever was our individual life situation when we grew up, bad and/or good, we all learn and we all go to the good parts, we must make it happen to the best of us.  Everything is possible, lets just do it. Let's make it happen. Let us keep the deep belief inside of us to bring out the power of all of us to the enlightenment.  Pure good resilience.  With Wisdom, Strength and Beauty to all of us and to our entire world.  To The Great Architect of The Universe (together).  There will always be clouds in the sky, surely the sun, stars and galaxies are here for us. Lets make it happen!  So be it." Christie's auction house, New York City, USA:  Twin Flames collection: CL7 bought the entire 100 original photographies signed and numbered collection of the Twin Flames physical collection by artist Justin Aversano (artist ranked number 1 in web3 photography, worldwide). Christie's NYC on Wednesday, October 6th 2021 for $1.1M, including the most rare and unique Twin Flame NFT's sold at Christie's NYC as well.  Henry Cartier Bresson: 2 main art pieces at same auction. metadata.about: As a house for photography and media art, the Francisco Carolinum is highly relevant in the international art discourse and enjoys an excellent reputation. Its focus on international positions makes it an important venue for global discourse in contemporary photography and media art. The museum's exhibitions, ranging from traditional photography to experimental media art, are known for their boundary-pushing and innovative perspectives. The Francisco Carolinum stands out for its ability to address current developments in art forms and to integrate them into a broader cultural and social context. As the world's first museum in the metaverse, the Digital Francisco Carolinum (DFC) was founded in April 2021 in the blockchain-based world of Voxels. The DFC represents a milestone in the evolution of the international museum landscape. Since then, it has regularly curated digital art exhibitions. In 2021, the Francisco Carolinum has also begun an ever-growing collection of NFTs across different blockchains. The support and curation of the DFC is in the hands of curators specialised in digital art and the metaverse. Their expertise ensures that the museum always presents current and relevant content, taking into account the latest developments in the field of digital art.

The Francisco Carolinum presents a collection to celebrate the 200th anniversary of Anton Bruckner’s birth. Poet Ana María Caballero responds to a marriage proposal written by Bruckner, creating a poetic dialogue between his private words and her contemporary interpretation. The work is preserved and shared through Bitcoin inscriptions, connecting tradition with digital innovation.

metadata.content: Anton Bruckner's marriage proposal to Miss Josefine Lang
metadata.transcript: Sehr verehrtes, liebenswürdiges Fräulein! Nicht als ob ich mich mit einer Ihnen befremdenden Angelegenheit an Sie, verehrtes Fräulein wenden würde; nein in der Überzeugung, daß Ihnen längst mein zwar stilles, aber beständiges Harren auf Sie bekannt ist, ergreife ich die Feder um Sie zu belästigen. Meine größte und innigste Bitte, die ich hiermit an Sie, Frl. Josefine zu richten wage, ist, Fräulein Josefine wollen mir gütigst offen und aufrichtig Ihre letzte und endgiltige, aber auch ganz entscheidende Antwort schriftlich zu meiner künftigen Beruhigung mittheilen und zwar über die Frage: Darf ich auf Sie hoffen und bei Ihren lieben Ältern um Ihre Hand werben? oder ist es Ihnen nicht möglich aus Mangel an persönlicher Zuneigung mit mir den ehelichen Schritt zu thun? Fräulein sehen, daß die Frage ganz entscheidend ist. Das eine oder andere bitte ich inständigst mir so bald als möglich aber so entschieden, aber gewiß, eben so entschieden zu schreiben. Bitte, sagen Fräulein Josefine dieß Ihren lieben Ältern aber sonst Niemanden (bitte das strengste Geheimniß bewahren zu wollen) und wählen Sie einen aus den vorgelegten zwei Punkten der Frage im Einverständnisse mit Ihren lieben Ältern. Mein treuer Freund, Ihr Herr Bruder hat bereits mich auf Alles vorbereitet und wird auch Sie schon seinem Versprechen gemäß verständigt haben. Nochmal meine Bitte: wollen Fräulein ganz offen u aufrichtig und ganz entschieden schreiben, entweder: ich darf um Sie werben, oder gänzliche ewige Absage; (kein Mittelding etwa vertrösten oder umschreiben, da bei mir die höchste Zeit bereits vorhanden ist,) ((zudem wird sich Ihr Gefühl nicht leicht verändern, weil Fräulein sehr vernünftig sind.)) Fräulein dürfen die reine Wahrheit mir unbesorgt sagen, weil selbe in jedem Falle mir Beruhigung gewähren wird. Mit Handkuss einer möglichst baldigen entschiedenen Antwort entgegen harrend. Linz den 16. August 1866 / Anton Bruckner m.p.
metadata.translation: Most esteemed and gracious Miss! It is not that I am approaching you with a matter that might seem strange or unsettling to you, dear Miss; rather, it is my conviction that you have long been aware of my silent but constant yearning for you, and so I take up the pen to burden you. My greatest and most heartfelt request, which I hereby dare to address to you, Miss Josefine, is that you kindly give me your final and definite, but also very decisive answer in writing for my future peace of mind, and that is about the question: May I hope for you and ask your dear parents for your hand in marriage? Or is it not possible for you to take the marital step with me due to a want of personal affection? Miss Josefine, you can see that the question is of utmost importance. I implore you to write me one or the other as soon as possible, but with the utmost clarity and certainty. Please, Miss Josefine, tell this to your dear parents but to no one else (please promise to keep this a strict secret) and choose one of the two points of the question in agreement with your dear parents. My faithful friend, your brother has already prepared me for everything and will also have informed you of his promise. Once again, my request: please write to me openly and sincerely and quite firmly, either: I may court you, or a complete and eternal refusal; (do not delay or offer an ambiguous middle ground, as I am already of advanced age,)(moreover, your feelings will not change easily, rational and reasonable young lady.) You may tell me the plain truth without worrying, because it will in any case reassure me. With a kiss upon your hand, awaiting your prompt and decisive reply. Linz, 16 August 1866 / Anton Bruckner m.p.

metadata.title: Arrangements
metadata.description: The Francisco Carolinum Linz presents 'Arrangements' on the occasion of the 200th anniversary of the birth of the famous Austrian composer Anton Bruckner. The poem, written by Ana María Caballero, is a contemporary response to Bruckner's tender proposal to 'Fräulein Josefine'. Based on this poetic dialogue, 824 generative works have been created with the support of Studio Harto to honour the musician's legacy. Realised by Ancora, this project redefines how art is preserved and shared.

metadata.Description: Time Fragments explores the fleeting nature of existence and the remnants we leave behind as moments of time slip away. Each piece is a fragment of a greater animated whole, reflecting the balance between individuality and a shared universal narrative. Rooted in surrealist aesthetics and infused with vibrant psychedelic energy, the collection invites viewers to reflect on the ephemeral beauty of life and how its fragmented moments shape our lasting legacies.
This inscription serves as the parent inscription for standalone artworks by Eka

metadata.Title: Test Object #1 (#TEST)
metadata.Statement:
This is a test piece to explore how metadata is displayed. It is part of a trio, with corresponding test inscriptions on specific Satoshis:

### Variation 1:
Sat: 0000000000
Inscription: 00000000

Sat: 0000000000
Inscription: 00000000

### Variation 2:
- **Sat:** 0000000000 | **Inscription:** 00000000
- **Sat:** 0000000000 | **Inscription:** 00000000

### Variation 3:
Information:
1. Sat: 0000000000 - Inscription: 00000000
2. Sat: 0000000000 - Inscription: 00000000

These variations are included to test how explorers render different ways of displaying information.

### Image File Test:
This image file was inscribed as an AVIF file but renamed as a JPG for testing purposes.

To view the image, you may need to download it and manually change its extension from `.jpg` to `.avif`.

This demonstrates a method of inscribing images that are hidden in explorers but can be uncovered once the process is known.

Another possibility is that the image displays directly, with the file type expressed as a JPG. This would be the most interesting outcome and is the primary focus of this test.

### Testing Paragraphs:
This test block explores the possibility of creating structured paragraphs under a single header. Testing paragraphs allows for better formatting of the metadata:

- **First Test Paragraph:** This is a test description that should appear in its own paragraph. It discusses how the metadata appears.

- **Second Test Paragraph:** This paragraph continues the test by explaining additional details. The purpose is to observe how explorers render formatted text.

### Summary:
Testing is essential for ensuring that metadata appears as intended in inscriptions. This is a test piece.

At the time of this inscription, this Ordinal is part of a trio, with the other two corresponding Ordinals inscribed on the following Satoshis:
- Sat 150289646982051 – Inscription 74646365
- Sat 673054575450376 – Inscription 74671883

Both these inscriptions were made on 20th August 2024.

These two Ordinals currently have no metadata or defined parent-child relationships. However, this statement serves to officially establish that these Ordinals, inscribed on Palindrome Sats, are part of The Hi-Def Derivative Art Collection (The Specials).

The standard display configuration for these three images positions this Ordinal as the central panel, flanked by Sat 673054575450376 on its left and Sat 150289646982051 on its right.

This inscription is a test piece. Nothing written here corresponds with the image inscribed. The purpose of this Ordinal is to observe how this text is displayed on blockchain explorers and to find out whether the inscribed image, which is an AVIF, that has been renamed as a PNG, will be called a PNG by explorers (in the same way I have discovered JPG currently appears in explorers if I rename an AVIF with this ending).

metadata.name: ARTIFACT - CryptoText Art V35
metadata.description: A dynamic inscription that merges cellular automata with blockchain data, creating an evolving digital artifact. The text 'ARTIFACT' emerges from and interacts with complex cellular patterns, while a triadic color scheme shifts in response to blockchain activity. Each block's data influences the artwork: merkle root determines the color palette, transaction count affects evolution speed, and block hash defines the cellular automata rule patterns.

merkle_root.effect: Determines base color for triadic harmony scheme

transaction_count.effect: Higher transaction counts increase cellular evolution rate

block_hash.effect: Last 2 bytes define cellular automata rules (0-255)
block_hash.significance: Creates unique pattern behaviors for each block, displayed as 'Rule X' in overlay

technical_features: WebGL fragment shader for cellular patterns
SVG text with dynamic wave animation
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with new blocks. Hover over the visualization to reveal detailed block information, including the current cellular automata rule number. The pattern behavior and color scheme will evolve with each new block.
metadata.artist_statement: ARTIFACT explores the intersection of deterministic chaos and blockchain data through cellular automata. Each block's data is transformed into a unique visual system, creating an ever-evolving digital artifact that reflects the state of the Bitcoin network. The rule number displayed in the overlay provides insight into the current cellular pattern's behavior, connecting the visual experience to the underlying mathematical systems.

metadata.description: An immersive, blockchain-responsive artwork that combines organic fluid dynamics with precise typography to explore the emergent nature of truth in decentralized systems. Featuring a custom WebGL shader implementing Fractional Brownian Motion (FBM) noise alongside the CryptoTextRNG system for deterministic randomization.
metadata.artist_statement: EMERGENT TRUTH explores the dynamic relationship between deterministic systems and emergent behavior, visualized through the lens of Bitcoin's blockchain. The artwork uses custom fluid dynamics algorithms to create organic movement patterns that respond to blockchain activity, while maintaining precise typographic elements that represent the fixed, immutable nature of blockchain data. The corner frames serve as windows into the blockchain's current state, creating a bridge between the artwork's aesthetic fluidity and the network's concrete data points.

Description.*: Altered Bloom (2024) by Harto is a lenticular artwork that transforms depending on the viewer's perspective, blurring the boundaries between abstraction and organic form. Inspired by Robert Mallary's exploration of texture, transformation, and digital processes, this piece reflects a modern interpretation of dynamic visual shifts.
Description.·: Composed of intricate layers of floral and geometric patterns, Altered Bloom captures the tension between natural growth and technological precision. Its vibrant colors and evolving forms evoke a sense of metamorphosis, challenging the viewer to explore perception and meaning through movement and light.
Description.-: Printed using a lenticular technique, the artwork invites multiple interpretations, aligning with Mallary's legacy of abstraction and structured complexity. Altered Bloom serves as both homage and innovation, offering a contemporary dialogue between tradition and modernity.

metadata.biography: Šima Müllerová (*1999) is a directrise, audiovisual artist and storyteller who studied photography at the Royal Academy of Arts, The Hague finishing her educational path at the Department of Documentary Filmmaking, FAMU, Prague.
metadata.scope: In her work, she moves on the edge of reality and offers its starting points through fantasy images. Rather than observed reality, she explores various images of inner realities and other intangible spaces. In her films she works extensively with the musical component and also ventures into the world of music videos.

metadata.Quilt: Image from final BFA Show at UIowa in 2014 titled "Gingham Check". I cut up a lot of my undergraduate paintings to resew into a quilt. At the time, I felt no matter how good I got technically at something my identity and socio-economic class would always be a barrier. Quilts are generally considered a folk art, while I was persuing a fine art of painting. The disassembly became a form of protest and meditation. The reassembly made my hands bleed and hurt so bad because oil paint covered canvas is not suppose to be sewn. I left the physical at school when I graduated - I don't know if they kept it or trashed it. <3 Empress Trash

metadata.biography: Kyiv 05.11.2000 I was born in a family of two engineers. /___/ From that moment on in my life, I began to be surrounded by creativity, balance, perfectionism, elegance, wisdom, and hard work. /___/ I graduated from the University of Architecture in Kyiv because my father said I wouldn't become an architect. /___/ I became an architect, but I realized I didn't want to be one. /___/ I also graduated from art school, but I don't consider myself an artist. /___/ In my life I would like to create something, maybe it can be attributed to art, because most of our improvised things are paper and paints. But I would like to create ideas, to embody thoughts. To be that human protest - to shout without opening my mouth, to shout good things so that people believe in themselves. /___/There was no one in my life who would do this. /___/Therefore, I want to become such a person for myself and for others. /___/My works are not about art, beauty, colors, good/bad drawing skills, I don't evaluate them by these criteria myself. They're about supporting an idea. They're maybe about supporting someone./Shelest/Шелест/
